## Care does not fail because of people. It fails because of the stucture  The amount of people who need care is growing but,  ![Ältere Frau mit grauen Haaren lächelt einen Mann in medizinischer Schutzkleidung an.](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/69bbf90e3c8f16b775c7ee11/69d8b47ca32290f4d738f7e3_intro-01.avif)  ![Sanfter Farbverlauf von Blau links zu Orange rechts mit weißem Übergang in der Mitte.](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/69bbf90e3c8f16b775c7ee11/69bc856abf567f34010462f0_gradient-01.avif)    at the same time, there are not enough hands to help. Those who already work in care are spending more and more time on documentation, instead of with the people who actually need them.   ![Zwei Personen mit Masken schauen gemeinsam auf ein Smartphone in einem Innenraum, möglicherweise einer medizinischen Einrichtung.](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/69bbf90e3c8f16b775c7ee11/69bc856a1993ce9ba6b308f5_magazine-thum-01.avif)  ![Sanfter Farbverlauf von Blau links zu Orange rechts mit weißem Übergang in der Mitte.](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/69bbf90e3c8f16b775c7ee11/69bc856abf567f34010462f0_gradient-01.avif)      This is not a failure of caregivers.  ![Hand hält unterstützend den Arm einer älteren Person.](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/69bbf90e3c8f16b775c7ee11/69d8b47cfddc7b94bc1d212e_intro-03.avif)  ![Sanfter Farbverlauf von Blau links zu Orange rechts mit weißem Übergang in der Mitte.](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/69bbf90e3c8f16b775c7ee11/69bc856abf567f34010462f0_gradient-01.avif)    It is a systemic failure. And that is exactly where voize comes in.

## Our story starts here

voize began when our two founders, Marcel and Fabio, moved their grandfather into a care facility where they witnessed first-hand the amount of time nurses were forced to spend on documentation, rather than with the people who needed care. It was a system built to sustain bureaucracy, not the people within it.

Unable to forget this experience, Marcel and Fabio worked hand-in-hand with nursing staff to develop voize: a solution as simple as speaking.
